from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r in range(h) if bg not in g[r]]
    cs=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(h))]
    # the most common non-background color at lattice intersections is the separator color
    vals=[g[r][c] for r in rs for c in cs]
    line=Counter(v for v in vals if v!=bg).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_cols=[c for c in cs if any(g[r][c] not in (bg,line) for r in rs)]
    cmin,cmax=min(marker_cols),max(marker_cols)
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in zip(rs,rs[1:]):
        row=[]
        use=[c for c in cs if cmin<=c<=cmax]
        for c0,c1 in zip(use,use[1:]):
            q=[g[r0][c0],g[r0][c1],g[r1][c0],g[r1][c1]]
            row.append(q[0] if q[0]!=line and q[0]!=bg and all(x==q[0] for x in q) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The repeated interior color is the value left in unmarked output cells.
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    boundary_rows = [r for r in range(h) if background not in grid[r]]
    boundary_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h))]
    # The most common non-background color forms the unmarked lattice lines.
    line_color = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marked_cols = [c for c in boundary_cols
                   if any(grid[r][c] not in (background, line_color) for r in boundary_rows)]
    left, right = min(marked_cols), max(marked_cols)
    cols = [c for c in boundary_cols if left <= c <= right]

    output = []
    for top, bottom in zip(boundary_rows, boundary_rows[1:]):
        out_row = []
        for left_col, right_col in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[top][left_col], grid[top][right_col],
                       grid[bottom][left_col], grid[bottom][right_col])
            color = corners[0]
            if color in (background, line_color) or any(v != color for v in corners):
                color = background
            out_row.append(color)
        output.append(out_row)
    return output
'''
